title: GetApiKeyResponseObj
description: Response object that provides detailed information about an existing API key, including its current status, capabilities, and permissions.

keyID.description: A unique identifier for the API key. This ID is used to reference and manage the key programmatically.

hmacEnabled.description: Indicates whether HMAC-based authentication is enabled for this API key. If true, requests authenticated with this key must be signed using HMAC.

enabled.description: Represents whether the API key is currently active and allowed to be used. If set to false, the key is considered disabled and cannot be used for authentication.

permittedOperations.description: A list of operations that the API key is authorized to perform. These may correspond to specific API actions, endpoints, or permission scopes.
